title: Add --quiet to podman artifact ls
body: Problem: Right now there's no clean way to get just artifact IDs (The Digest hashcodes) out of podman artifact ls. You end up either parsing the table or reaching for --format {{.Digest}}, which is inefficient for scripting. The other list commands (images, ps, artifact push/pull) all have -q/--quiet already pre-existing. Impact: users can now run `podman artifact ls --quiet` to get one digest per line (the unique hashcode), no header, suitable for piping into other podman commands. Change: adds a `--quiet`/`-q` bool flag to the list command.
